basic_info.description: Elegant, top-floor condominium blending 1920s charm with modern upgrades in a prime Mission/Valencia/Noe location. This spacious, light-filled flat features a full-width living room with bay windows and a wood-burning fireplace, formal dining room, and beautifully remodeled kitchen with Carrera marble counters, stainless steel appliances, and breakfast nook. Period details include coved ceilings, hardwood floors with inlays, wood trim, and French doors. Two large rear bedrooms enjoy southeast views toward Bernal Hill; the primary suite features a newly added en-suite bath with custom tile. A sunroom offers flexible space for an office or nursery. Additional highlights: in-unit laundry, updated systems (plumbing, electrical, heating), and garage parking. Nestled at the nexus of Noe, the Inner Mission, and the Valencia Corridor with a 97 Walk Score, just steps to cafes, parks, and transit. A rare find with scale, style, and location.
